label: Family Room Mic Health
info:
Alerts when the family-room ReSpeaker wedges.

pw-poller-pi runs mic_health.sh on a 10-min timer and publishes RETAINED JSON to familyroom/satellite/mic_health. A wedged array shows the ALSA capture substream RUNNING with hw_ptr frozen at 0.

Only a PHYSICAL replug clears the wedge — usb reset, unbind/rebind, snd_usb_audio reload and even a full power-down all fail.

Transition-only, and targeted at global.BradPhoneNM (not broadcast).

nodes.name: transition -> alert (brad only)
